summary: Comprehensive testing of TruthScan MVP - all core features verified. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: All pages and flows working correctly.

issues: Stat card values show as '0' with loading spinner for brand new users - expected behavior but worth confirming spinner resolves properly

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 557 lines - acceptable but monitor growth
JWT_SECRET falls back to random secrets.token_hex(32) if not in env - this means all sessions invalidate on restart; should use a fixed secret in .env for production
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login - brute force attacks possible (playbook requires brute force lockout after 5 fails)
Admin password stored in .env as ADMIN_PASSWORD - bcrypt hash format $2b$ is used correctly via hash_password()
CORS allows both FRONTEND_URL and localhost:3000 hardcoded - fine for dev but remove hardcoded localhost in production
seed_data_creation: Created test users via registration during testing (uitest*@test.com)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All MVP features verified and working. Backend 16/16 passing. Key concern: no brute force lockout on login endpoint. JWT_SECRET uses random fallback if not set in .env. All frontend flows: landing, analyzer (guest+auth), signup, login, dashboard (charts+history), about, logout all working.
rca_of_issue: No critical bugs found. One architectural concern: JWT_SECRET should be persisted in backend/.env to avoid session invalidation on server restart.
